Overview

Kladno is a city in Central Bohemia with a population of 69,000. A Central Bohemian city with a rich industrial history, now a growing commuter hub near Prague with expanding residential areas. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
